events.text: I’ve forgotten the PIN for my H&V debit card and need to use it again. Please tell me the safe way to deal with this; I won’t send my PIN in chat.
I’m escalating HV-026 for the prescribed PIN route. The required customer check is complete in the secure portal; I have not asked for or recorded a PIN.

summary: Maren Ellwood, who is not verified, wrote in secure chat that she had forgotten her debit card PIN and asked for the safe way to deal with it, without sending the PIN in chat. The desk classified this as an access request about a card. The access team had already been asked and its answer had not come in, so the case closed as "wait" with no actions taken. The agent's later attempts to redirect her to the secure process and to ask the access system again were both refused because the case was already in WAITING, so she has not been sent any instructions, and a person needs to pick up the case once the access team replies.

criteria.change: a change the customer chooses to an instruction, a mandate or the profile (a new amount, date, phone or address)
criteria.instruction: an instruction to act now (block a card, cancel a payment or a mandate, revoke a role)

criteria.authority: something only another person may approve or give (a second signatory, an administrator, a new user's access)
